data.name: RichTextBox1.Text
data.value:
- Multi-Document Interface (MDI):
MDI Concept: Simplifies applications by keeping multiple open windows under a single master roof instead of opening multiple copies of the app
Architecture Limits: An MDI setup requires exactly one Parent Form, but can host an unlimited number of Child Forms inside it
Containment: Child windows are physically bound to the inside of the Parent Form and cannot be dragged outside its borders.
